description: Check monitored websites for changes and alert on detection

steps.prompt: Use memory_search with tag 'monitor' to find all URLs being monitored. For each URL, note the CSS selector (if any) and last known hash.
For each monitored URL found in the previous step, use browse_monitor to check for changes. Collect all results noting which sites changed and which are unchanged.
For any sites that changed, use browse_url to get the full updated content. Summarize what changed compared to the previous version. Store the new version hash in memory.
If any sites changed, send an alert via the notification channel with the summary of changes. Format: '🔔 Site Change Detected\n\n[URL]: [summary of changes]'. If no sites changed, skip this step.
